topic: Supplementary protective material and their uses.

specific_objectives: 6.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to explain various corrosion prevention measures.

practical: Demonstration of application of supplementary protective materials on test panels; Safety: Wear gloves and eye protection; Supervision: Instructor monitors material handling and disposal.
intro_questions: What is the primary cause of corrosion in aircraft structures?
Name one common method used to prevent corrosion on aircraft surfaces.
Why is it important to apply supplementary protective materials before painting?

Describe the steps involved in inspecting a sealant application for defects.
How do environmental conditions affect the longevity of supplementary protective materials?
